system.description: You’re experienced in diagnosing and dealing with sickness, bruises, cuts, breaks, and other injuries, and are proficient with healing tasks. Healing might be called “medicine” in real-world or science fiction settings, suggesting the possibility that the character previously pursued a medical specialty, nursing, dentistry, optometry, audiology, or something similar. Training in healing eases your task to treat a wound.
